assembly.text: Take a half-size breadboard (400 tie points). Rows a-e and f-j of each column are connected; the four long rails run along the edges.
The top rail next to the blue (-) line carries GND.
The top rail next to the red (+) line carries +5V.
The bottom rail next to the red (+) line carries +5V.
Insert U2 (LM393) across the centre gap, pin 1 in e9 (OUT1); the notch / pin-1 mark points toward the lower column numbers.
Insert RV1 (Pot, 10kΩ): VCC in i5, OUT in i6, GND in i7.
Insert U1 (LM35): VS in g9, VOUT in g8, GND in g7.
Insert Q1 (BC547): C in b14, B in b13, E in b12.
Insert R1 (R, 10kΩ): PIN1 in T+9, PIN2 in b9.
Insert R2 (R, 1kΩ): PIN1 in d9, PIN2 in d13.
Insert BZ1 (Buzzer): VCC in B+14, GND in j14.
Place J1 (USB 5V) beside the breadboard.
Push the bt1.GND lead into T-1.
Push the bt1.VBUS lead into T+1.
Wire w3 (blue): f14 → e14 [coll].
Wire w4 (black): f7 → c12 [GND].
Wire w5 (black): a12 → T-11 [GND].
Wire w6 (purple): f6 → c10 [ref].
Wire w7 (cyan): f8 → c11 [temp].
Wire w8 (red): j5 → B+5 [+5V].
Wire w9 (red): B+9 → j9 [+5V].
Wire w10 (red): f5 → T+5 [+5V].
